name: pico-ai-bridge
description: Unofficial MCP bridge that lets Claude use models running on your own Pico AI Server (formerly Pico AI Homelab). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Starling Protocol, the developer of Pico AI Server.
long_description: Unofficial bridge with six MCP tools for server information, merged model listing, Responses, chat completions, Ollama chat, and sequential comparison.

base_url.title: Pico base URL
base_url.description: URL of your Pico AI Server, including port, e.g. http://localhost:11434. Do not include credentials; use the API key setting.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Optional Pico API key; sent as a Bearer token.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (milliseconds)
timeout_ms.description: Caller timeout in milliseconds, from 1 through 2147483647; sent requests continue and hold their FIFO permit until Pico finishes.

max_concurrent_requests.title: Maximum concurrent requests
max_concurrent_requests.description: FIFO limit on simultaneous Pico HTTP requests: a whole number from 1 through 9007199254740991; default is one.

tools.name: pico_server_info
tools.description: Read /api/version; raw mode returns HTTP status and parsed body.

tools.name: pico_list_models
tools.description: Merge /v1/models and /api/tags; optionally inspect each merged model with /api/show.

tools.name: pico_responses
tools.description: Generate through /v1/responses with string or item-array input.

tools.name: pico_chat_completions
tools.description: Generate through /v1/chat/completions with prompt or messages.

tools.name: pico_ollama_chat
tools.description: Generate through /api/chat with prompt or messages.

tools.name: pico_compare_models
tools.description: Compare at least two models sequentially through a selected API.
